notes: All mission distances/timers are placeholders to tune using measured routes.
destination_id strings are provisional; replace with scene/POI IDs.
Fire spots and fix interactions may use arrive-to-resolve prototype mode.
All dialogue should be voiced or icon-assisted for pre-readers.
Collection items must be physically reachable; do not spawn on roofs or buildings.
character_id identifies the mission requester; playable_character_ids identifies who the player controls.
Bunny is the default playable hero on every mission and the only playable hero on Fire missions.
Additional playable heroes are optional per mission and must not gate mission completion.
Untimed collection missions use failure dialogue only for cancellation or an unrecoverable placement; they never expire by time.
The optional ring mini-race is a practice activity, not a prerequisite for the 41 core missions.
Dialogue sprite paths are repository-root relative and refer to transparent images in visuals/processed/.
Requester sprite is selected per line; Player uses sprite_by_playable_character_id for the selected hero. Dispatcher has no sprite.
